mapper.select: SELECT user_id as userid, username, password, email, name, profile_image, refresh_token FROM users WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT user_id as userid, username, password, email, name, profile_image, refresh_token FROM users WHERE refresh_token = #{refreshToken}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, password, email, name, profile_image) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{name}, #{profileImage})
